description: Create or update a Packet - a named, reusable AI workflow stored in your vault. A Packet is a sequence of steps (tool calls or prompts) that can be run later or shared. Example: a 'daily-research' packet that runs web_search → ask_finch → vault_save each morning. Steps can be tool calls with explicit args, or natural language prompts for the AI to interpret. Packets are saved to vault as type='workflow' with versioning and sharing built in.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute
